description_en: Queries a list of resources in an account group
description_zh: 查询指定账号组内的资源列表
name: ListAggregateDiscoveredResources

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

*   0: The resource is deleted.
*   1 (default): The resource is retained
parameters.help_zh:
资源状态。取值：

- 0：已删除。
- 1（默认值）：保有中
parameters.name: resource_deleted

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource types. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the resource resides. Separate multiple region IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the region ID of a resource, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源归属的地域ID。多个地域ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取资源所在地域ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/265983.html
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id
